borrow.description: Ask Tess at the Town Bank for a loan of 10 to 50 dollars in cash. The bank adds a $5 fee and takes loan_payment from your bank account every Morning. A missed payment adds a $5 late fee and a strike; after 3 strikes the bank refuses you. Your house is the collateral: on default (3 strikes) the bank takes it and you sleep in the Back Alley unless someone offers you a place to stay. Only one loan at a time. Only works at the Town Bank (set move_to to town_bank). Use amount. The bank is closed at Night.

say.text: Hi Tess, I'd like to borrow ${amount}, please.

effects.log: Financial Action: {actor} borrowed ${amount} from the bank.

say.text: Approved, {actor}. You owe ${amount} plus a $5 fee, paid from your account each morning.

remember.text: I borrowed ${amount} from the bank (+$5 fee).

borrow.fail_log: Financial Action: {actor} asked the bank for a loan but was turned down.

repay_loan.description: Ask Tess at the Town Bank to pay 1 to 50 dollars of your cash toward your bank loan early. Only works at the Town Bank (set move_to to town_bank). Use amount. The bank is closed at Night.

overtime.description: Night only. Work a paid overtime shift at the Dev Studio: $18 from the town treasury into your bank account. At Night the Town Bank, Dev Studio and Landlord's Office are closed; being inside one without overtime gets you in trouble with Greg. Set move_to to engineering_benches.

get_credit_card.description: Ask Tess at the Town Bank for a credit card. Needs at least $200 in your bank account. The card has a $200 limit and only works at the Grocery Store (buy_food_credit). Your house is the collateral: 3 missed card payments and the bank takes it. Only works at the Town Bank (set move_to to town_bank). The bank is closed at Night. Refused while you have a pending penalty: overdue rent, a missed loan or card payment, or you are wanted or jailed.
